snippet.title: ON LOVE, ON MONSTERS - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
What does it take to create life? What defines life in the first place? Who has the right to push the boundary of what we believe is human?

⚙︎・•●  *Can a "monster" learn to love?*  ● •・⚙︎

On Love, On Monsters is an upcoming indie visual novel—loosely inspired by the story of Frankenstein—by Lighthouse Theory Games, that explores the nature of love and personhood; how love can not only change us, but has the power to create as well as destroy depending on what we choose to do with it.

Follow the journey of our three main characters; Vee Moore, the Doctor, Emrys Hughes, the Priest, and Marion de la Mare, the Exile, as they navigate not only their past relationships, but present and future ones as well. 

Help them work towards the eventual creation of the Child, Theodora, by bonding with allies, avoiding suspicion, and laying the groundwork to bring their beloved "monster" to life.

𖤉

On Love, On Monsters is available to wishlist now! The demo will go live on 08/14/2026, and will be available to download and play for free on Steam!
